dct_description_sm: Cartographic Details: Scale 1:1,013,760 ; Statute miles, 16 = 1 in. (W 97°15'--W 89°30'/N 49°23'--N 43°30'). Red overprinting shows railroads. Title from upper margin. Title near copyright: Rand, McNally & Co.'s business atlas map of Minnesota. On verso: Minnesota. Counties, creeks, Indian reservations, lakes, rivers, and towns. Index in left margin. Includes list of "Minnesota Railroads." Insets: N.E. corner of state of Minnesota -- Minneapolis, St. Paul and vicinity.
